description: This file defines the ParamRule class, which is part of a validation framework within the OrangeHRM system. It manages validation rules for parameters, including associated rules, default values, and composite validation logic.

classes.name: ParamRule
classes.description: Represents validation rules for a specific API parameter, including constraints, default value, and composite validation logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ParamRule with a parameter key and a variadic list of Rule objects.

methods.name: getParamKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the parameter this rule applies to.

methods.name: setParamKey
methods.description: Sets the key of the parameter this rule applies to.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns the array of Rule objects associated with this parameter.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Sets the array of Rule objects for this parameter.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default value for the parameter if validation does not produce a value.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default value for the parameter.

methods.name: getCompositeClass
methods.description: Returns the composite validation class used for combining multiple rules.

methods.name: setCompositeClass
methods.description: Sets the composite validation class; throws ValidatorException if value is invalid.
